appearance_facts.fact: The chart title is 'Decreasing Number of New Tourists in Town Z from 1880 to 1891'.
The vertical axis is labeled 'Number of Tourists' and has tick marks at intervals of 500, from 0 to 3,500.
The horizontal axis is labeled 'Year' and spans from 1880 to 1891.
A single blue line connects data points for each year from 1880 to 1891.
The line starts at approximately 1,100 tourists in 1880, rises to a peak of about 1,600 in 1882, dips to about 1,300 in 1883, and then rises again to a peak of about 3,600 in 1890.
The line ends at approximately 3,200 tourists in 1891, which is lower than the 1890 peak.
The line shows a general upward trend from 1880 to 1890, followed by a downward trend from 1890 to 1891.
The final data point in 1891 is lower than the peak in 1890, but higher than the starting point in 1880.
